name: vwap_rsi_confluence_v1
author: claude-4.6-opus
thesis: Combining VWAP deviation with RSI extremes creates a double confirmation filter that dramatically reduces false signals. When price is >0.5% below VWAP AND RSI(14) < 30, the stock is both underpriced relative to institutional fair value AND oversold on momentum. The confluence of two independent signals (value + momentum) increases the probability of reversion. The edge exists because each signal alone has a ~50% base rate, but their intersection is much rarer and has a higher hit rate (~60%). Most traders use either VWAP or RSI, not both together with strict thresholds. The rarity of the combined signal also means it cannot be easily arbitraged away since trade frequency is low.

long.confirmation: RSI_slope > 0 (RSI turning up from below 30) AND close > open on current bar

short.confirmation: RSI_slope < 0 (RSI turning down from above 70) AND close < open on current bar

entry.entry_price: market order on confirmation bar close

exit.target: VWAP line (vwap_dev_pct crosses 0) OR RSI crosses 50, whichever first
exit.stop_loss: 0.4% from entry OR RSI makes new extreme (below 25 for longs, above 75 for shorts)
exit.signal_exit: exit if both vwap_dev_pct and RSI worsen simultaneously (deepening extreme)

risk.position_sizing: fixed 1L per trade; scale to 1.5L if daily P&L is positive

filters.vix_filter: India_VIX < 22; confluence signals in panic markets are unreliable
filters.time_filter: no entries before 09:45 (RSI needs warmup) or after 14:30
filters.trend_filter: prefer longs when NIFTY 50 is not in a downtrend (NIFTY > EMA(NIFTY, 20))
filters.event_filter: skip on budget day, RBI policy
other_filters: skip if stock gapped > 2% at open (gap distorts RSI)

edge.edge_decay_risk: low-moderate — confluence is simple conceptually but requires discipline to wait for both signals

weaknesses: Signal is rare — both VWAP deviation >0.5% AND RSI <30 simultaneously may occur only 1-2 times per day across entire universe
RSI on 1-min bars is extremely noisy; 14-period RSI on 1-min = 14 minutes of data, which is short for reliable RSI readings
During strong sell-offs, both conditions persist for extended periods — entry timing within the confluence zone is still difficult
prior_art: Multi-indicator confluence is standard TA practice. VWAP + RSI is mentioned in various trading education (SMB Capital, Investors Underground). The specific thresholds (0.5% deviation + RSI<30) and the RSI-slope confirmation add some specificity beyond generic confluence approaches.
notes: Edge math: 0.60 * 40bps - 0.40 * 33bps = 24 - 13.2 = 10.8 bps gross. Costs ~11 bps. Net ≈ -0.2 bps. Essentially breakeven. Need to either improve win rate to 0.62+ or improve W:L ratio. The strength of this strategy is low trade frequency (high-conviction only) which should push realized win rate above 0.60. Conservative estimates used here.
